acceptanceCheck: The canonical fixture catalog covers hostile, malformed, legacy, performance, recovery, publication, and tenant-isolation cases.
evidenceClass: Source review and deterministic fixture validation
rollbackCondition: Revert the dormant fixture catalog before any acceptance gate depends on it.

acceptanceCheck: The reviewed specification and registry contain the same unique requirement identifiers, and every registry entry has complete delivery metadata.
evidenceClass: Source review and deterministic registry validation
rollbackCondition: Revert the documentation and dormant registry before any implementation ticket consumes it.

acceptanceCheck: Authorized staging, device coverage, provider baselines, evidence manifests, and release reports produce privacy-safe evidence tied to immutable inputs.
evidenceClass: Staging attestation and evidence-manifest validation
rollbackCondition: Disable the dormant evidence collector and retain the last valid release process.

acceptanceCheck: A fresh database rebuild, generated-type drift check, hosted-configuration comparison, and deployment attestation agree with the tracked migration lineage.
evidenceClass: Database integration tests and provider attestation
rollbackCondition: Roll back the client and compatible expand migration to the recorded migration head without contracting shared schema early.

acceptanceCheck: Codec fixtures prove versioned decoding, sequential idempotent migration, canonical encoding, bounded rejection, quarantine, and non-overwrite behavior.
evidenceClass: Deterministic codec tests
rollbackCondition: Keep the codecs dormant or return readers to the previous compatible envelope while preserving unsupported values.

acceptanceCheck: Browser and Worker tests prove the publication entrypoint accepts unknown input, returns bounded outcomes, exposes only allowlisted facts, and carries independent interface versions.
evidenceClass: Cross-runtime publication contract tests
rollbackCondition: Restore the previous publication adapter and generic fallback while retaining the prior compatible manifest version.

acceptanceCheck: Authorized staging proves cross-tenant denial, owner success, minimal grants, fixed search paths, restricted execution, Realtime authorization, and complete account deletion.
evidenceClass: Hostile multi-tenant database integration tests
rollbackCondition: Stop promotion and restore the last attested schema and client pair if any tenant or privilege boundary fails.

acceptanceCheck: Backup tests fail before export when encryption is invalid and prove ciphertext upload, decryptability, integrity, retention, least privilege, and isolated restoration.
evidenceClass: Backup fault tests and restore evidence
rollbackCondition: Disable backup execution and use the last verified encrypted backup path; never fall back to plaintext export or upload.

acceptanceCheck: Protocol and staging tests prove owner-only publishing, viewer role restrictions, high-entropy capabilities, rotation, revocation, and bounded traffic.
evidenceClass: Protocol state-machine tests and authorized Realtime integration tests
rollbackCondition: Disable live sharing and revoke affected capabilities if publisher authority or capability invalidation cannot be proven.

acceptanceCheck: Route tests prove server-side challenge and share verification, bounded validation, deduplication, quotas, restricted insertion, and notification queue isolation.
evidenceClass: Cloudflare route integration and abuse-boundary tests
rollbackCondition: Disable anonymous reporting at the edge if verification, quotas, restricted insertion, or queue isolation fails.

acceptanceCheck: Lifecycle contract tests distinguish the working board, tab-scoped anonymous recovery, restart-safe signed-in recovery, and owner-scoped cloud copy.
evidenceClass: Encounter lifecycle contract tests
rollbackCondition: Keep the new recovery stores dormant and retain the current in-memory and session behavior.

acceptanceCheck: Fault tests prove every committed action enters recovery promptly, failures remain visible and playable, retry and download work, navigation warns, and two validated copies remain available.
evidenceClass: Deterministic storage fault tests and browser recovery journeys
rollbackCondition: Return to the previous persistence path only before the recovery cutover; after cutover, preserve and export both validated copies.

acceptanceCheck: Database and lifecycle tests prove atomic expected revisions, writer leases, retained history, takeover checkpoints, and read-only stale writers.
evidenceClass: Database concurrency integration tests and lifecycle contract tests
rollbackCondition: Stop cloud writes and continue from device recovery if revision or lease guarantees fail; preserve all retained revisions.

acceptanceCheck: Reconciliation tests prove descendant selection, explicit divergence, preservation and download of both copies, stable roll identifiers, and safe authentication expiry.
evidenceClass: Deterministic reconciliation tests and browser conflict journeys
rollbackCondition: Stop automatic cloud reconciliation and require recovery-copy selection if ancestry or identity cannot be established.

acceptanceCheck: Protocol and browser tests prove all freshness states, update age, the 30-second stale cover, immediate access termination, and fresh validated recovery.
evidenceClass: Protocol state-machine tests and player-view browser journeys
rollbackCondition: End the live session and hide stale content if validated freshness or authorization state cannot be determined.

acceptanceCheck: Browser recovery journeys prove controlled offline reopening, deferred activation during a fight, checkpointed updates, and preservation of the previous validated shell.
evidenceClass: Service-worker integration and offline browser tests
rollbackCondition: Serve the previous validated shell and unregister the candidate worker if installation, activation, or checkpoint validation fails.

acceptanceCheck: Mixed-version release tests prove expand-and-contract compatibility, promotion checks, rollback before contraction, and rejection of unsafe irreversible migrations.
evidenceClass: Coordinated deployment and rollback tests
rollbackCondition: Return client and routes to the recorded compatible commits while leaving expanded schema in place through the rollback window.

acceptanceCheck: An isolated staged restore meets the recovery targets and verifies deletion handling, tenant isolation, authentication, row counts, critical functions, encounter integrity, and monitoring.
evidenceClass: Timed isolated restore drill and monitoring evidence
rollbackCondition: Block promotion and continue from the last verified encrypted recovery point if restore integrity or deletion replay fails.

acceptanceCheck: Heap snapshots attribute retained growth, the complete mixed-action soak stays within 10 percent after warm-up and garbage collection, and the fresh-fight retest passes.
evidenceClass: Heap-profile analysis and performance benchmark
rollbackCondition: Revert the attributed retention change if the soak or fresh-fight budget regresses; do not delete authored encounter history.

acceptanceCheck: Constrained-profile evidence keeps first search at or below 4.8 seconds for remediation and never above six seconds, with later searches within 200 milliseconds.
evidenceClass: Compendium search benchmark and payload analysis
rollbackCondition: Restore the previous generated payload or index when constrained first or subsequent search regresses.

acceptanceCheck: Route-specific bundle evidence proves the published route and player view remain below 175 KiB compressed, the console below 325 KiB, and any 10 percent baseline regression is investigated.
evidenceClass: Production bundle composition and transfer-budget checks
rollbackCondition: Revert the route or bundle change that breaches an absolute budget or has an unexplained baseline regression.

acceptanceCheck: The maintained browser, device, input, zoom, display-preference, and assistive-technology journeys complete with accurate tested-combination reporting.
evidenceClass: Automated accessibility checks and manual compatibility matrix
rollbackCondition: Revert the interaction change or document the combination as Not measured; do not claim hardened status while required coverage is missing.

acceptanceCheck: Required application paths pass an enforced Content Security Policy after privacy-safe report-only evidence shows no required violation.
evidenceClass: CSP route tests and redacted violation evidence
rollbackCondition: Return to the last safe enforced policy or privacy-safe reporting mode if a required path is blocked.

acceptanceCheck: Public route tests prove bounded upstream timeouts, normalized cache keys, payload limits, route-specific rate limits, coarse thresholds, correct statuses, and privacy-safe request identifiers.
evidenceClass: Cloudflare route integration and abuse-load tests
rollbackCondition: Disable or fall back the affected public route when its work, cache, or abuse boundary cannot be bounded.

acceptanceCheck: Redacted source-controlled baselines cover every named provider and fail on unexplained drift affecting authentication, tenant isolation, secrets, backups, or public access.
evidenceClass: Provider-configuration comparison and drift report
rollbackCondition: Block promotion and restore the last reviewed provider baseline when critical configuration drift is unexplained.

acceptanceCheck: The incident matrix names evidence, redaction, retention, threshold, owner, and response for each mandatory signal, and staged exercises prove delivery and runbook use.
evidenceClass: Source review and staged monitoring exercise
rollbackCondition: Keep the previous alert path active until the replacement signal, redaction, owner, and runbook pass a staged exercise.

acceptanceCheck: The combined pull-request gate runs every applicable formatting, static, test, build, security, dependency, migration, fixture, benchmark, and route-boundary check and fails on missing checks.
evidenceClass: Combined pull-request evidence manifest
rollbackCondition: Restore the last complete required-check set if path selection omits or bypasses an applicable gate.

acceptanceCheck: Production promotion requires passing pull-request evidence, staging attestation, applicable migration and configuration evidence, backup health, route and assembly evidence, coordinated commits, approval, and a tested rollback target.
evidenceClass: Protected production-release attestation
rollbackCondition: Stop promotion or return every coordinated repository and provider to the recorded rollback target when a mandatory gate fails.

acceptanceCheck: The hardened-release gate refreshes or validly reuses complete performance, browser, device, accessibility, fault, restore, monitoring, and residual-risk evidence and blocks ineligible or expired risk acceptance.
evidenceClass: Hardened-release evidence manifest and maintainer approval
rollbackCondition: Withdraw the hardened-release claim and restore the coordinated rollback target when complete evidence or an eligible risk decision is absent.
